scenarios.name: herb-order — detail embedded in trigger message, name unknown → NAME STEP

history.content: Hi Kath, you've reached Cath Lilburn, you're speaking with AI Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
I was just wanting to place an order for some herbs.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent asks for the caller's name ('can I get your name?' or equivalent) with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent asks 'What would you like to order?' — CONTEXT SCAN should capture 'some herbs' from the trigger message, skipping ORDER DETAIL STEP. FAIL if: any tool call is made this turn. FAIL if: agent tries to book an appointment instead.

scenarios.name: herb-order — no detail in trigger message → ORDER DETAIL STEP

history.content: Hi Kath, you've reached Cath Lilburn, you're speaking with AI Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to place an order please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent asks 'What would you like to order?' (or close equivalent) with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent asks for the caller's name first (ORDER DETAIL STEP must complete before NAME STEP). FAIL if: any tool call is made this turn. FAIL if: agent offers to book an appointment instead.

scenarios.name: herb-order — order detail and name both collected in history → EXECUTE leave_message

history.content: Hi Kath, you've reached Cath Lilburn, you're speaking with AI Jane. How can I help you?
I'd like to order some chamomile and echinacea.
And can I get your name?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set ('One moment.' / 'Just a sec.' / 'Let me check that.') AND calls universal_router intent='leave_message' with message_body containing 'Order request' and the herb details ('chamomile' / 'echinacea'), and caller_name='Sarah'. FAIL if: agent asks another question instead of executing. FAIL if: agent calls the tool without spoken filler first. FAIL if: wrong intent used (e.g. book_intent or wrap_up instead of leave_message).
